verdict.rationale: The published guidance surface on www.sos.state.tx.us (corp index, forms directory, copies and fees page, SOSPortal info page) was retrieved and quoted directly, and the forms directory with instructions is downloadable without an account. Nothing shows a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA on these pages. The named AI-crawler bans in robots.txt apply to the separate direct.sos.state.tx.us filing host, not to the guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit probe of the www host (HTTP status, robots.txt, user-agent handling) and independent confirmation that no anti-bot challenge is served there.
